programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The Maury Show: I Cheated With My Daughter's Girlfriend
programme.desc: These women are desperate to hear MAURY say the words “YOU ARE THE FATHER!” But these men want to hear him say “YOU ARE NOT THE FATHER!” But only MAURY’s got the results they’re looking for!

programme.title: The Maury Show: I'll Prove You Are Cheating on My Teen!
programme.desc: Instead of chocolates and dinners, these guests are being cheated on and dumped. Love may be blind, but lie detector tests and hidden cameras will reveal the truth!

programme.title: The Maury Show: I'm Back for My 3rd Test... I'll Prove I'm Not the Father Again
programme.desc: Chris cheated and impregnated Lakin's neighbor. He denies he fathered Lakin’s baby. Then, John’s back for a 3rd DNA test. Can Jade prove that he’s the father or is her record 0-3?

programme.title: The Maury Show: Teen DNA... I'll Prove You Got Me Pregnant at 15!
programme.desc: Keith is terrified that Chyna cheated and their daughter may not be his. Could Keith’s best friend be the real father? Will the DNA results quash Omar's denials about fathering Jennifer’s child?

programme.title: The Maury Show: Is My Man Sleeping With My Teen Nephew?
programme.desc: Nikki won’t marry Will until he proves he’s faithful, but what did our hidden cameras confirm? Then, teens Jessica and Sean are days away from marriage. Could Sean be cheating with her best friend?

programme.title: The Maury Show: I Slept With Your Fiance... I'll Prove My 2 Kids Are His!
programme.desc: Did Selina's fiancé Thomas secretly father a baby with his ex-girlfriend and has Victoria been cheating on Brian? They'll take the test to find out on Maury today!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Powder Kegs
programme.desc: When uninvited guests crash a barrio birthday party, violence erupts—leaving Enrique Urrutia dead and potentially sparking a gang war.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Collision Course
programme.desc: Two best friends are gunned down on a dark residential street. When a string of disappointments threaten to derail the case, Kenda enlists the help of an old acquaintance.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Pop Goes the Witness
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Willie McCarty is found at the base of a staircase. Neighbors direct Kenda to a truck spotted fleeing the scene, but a surprise visitor at CSPD turns the case on its head.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Rearview Mirror
programme.desc: When a retired military man runs over a pedestrian, it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine if it was bad brakes or bad intent.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Case That Haunts Me
programme.desc: As Det. Joe Kenda digs into another murder, he uncovers a world of violence and sexual fetishes, culminating in perhaps the most intense interrogation of his career.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 120
programme.desc: For at fejre én af Fyns fineste ambassadører Hjalmer Larsen bliver der serveret brunssviger, spillet helt ny musik og snakket om kærestens begejstring over Hjalmers overskæg. Og så får vi fornøjelsen af Hjalmers bare røv!

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 121
programme.desc: Heavy Metal-fan Magnus Millang får en flot growling-velkomst på Breinholts. Men der bliver også snakket om Magnus passion for fotografering – og ost. For hvem husker ikke Emmenthaler-krisen i 80´erne?

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 122
programme.desc: EM skal skydes i gang, og det fejrer Anders og Malte Ebert i Breinholts. Vi skal høre en bid af Maltes nye landsholdssang – og så har Anders planlagt en KÆMPE overraskelse, der kommer trillende med to fodbold-legender.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 123
programme.desc: Når Søs Egelind besøger Breinholts, er der tid til både vendespil, guest appearance fra Molly og kunstige tænder. Og selvfølgelig en inside-snak om nogle af Kongerigets største karakterer. Og hov – kommer Søs måske en lille afsløring til sidst?

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 124
programme.desc: I dagens afsnit får Anders sit livs største skideballe af selveste mr. “Sæt i gang!” – Jakob Kjeldbjerg. Netop hjemvendt fra Malaysia er han klar med klip og røverhistorier fra de sidste 20 år med Robinson.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 101
programme.desc: Sofie Linde er den allerførste gæst, Anders inviterer indenfor – og han har en kæmpe overraskelse til hende. Det involverer Langeland, en hemmelig aftale med nogle naboer og en 150 kg tung træfigur.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 102
programme.desc: Benjamin Hav, musiker og kgl. Hofleverandør, besøger Anders. De to får sig en solid snak om toiletvaner, billedkunst og deres forkærlighed for Søs Egelind.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Musicallen: Del 2
programme.desc: Da Frankini lægger en musikalsk forbandelse over Swellview, må Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand finde på noget, som kan redde dem alle. Men da Kaptajn Mand bukker under for presset, må Faredrengen igen minde ham om, hvordan en helt opfører sig.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Historien om to gange Piper
programme.desc: Henry får uventet besøg af en person, som påstår at komme fra fremtiden. Da en dræbermaskine i form af en drengerobot træder ind på scenen, må de finde en måde at redde alle fra en apokalyptisk fremtid.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Søsterbøvl: Del 1
programme.desc: Pakker bliver stjålet fra Swellviews verandaer. Henry og Ray iværksætter en overvågning for at fange tyven på fersk gerning.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Søsterbøvl: Del 2
programme.desc: Da Rays hukommelse ved et uheld bliver slettet, udtænker Schwoz en plan, som skal sende Henry dybt ind i Rays hjerne for at få den tilbage.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Mor
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand opfører sig barnligt om det at skulle føde et barn. Fødselsveerne gør ham hjælpeløs, så Faredrengen og Piper må træde til for at stoppe et par fedtede fedttyve.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Synlige Brad
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen får brug for en lille smule magi og noget hjælp fra en gammel ven, hvis de vil fange en tyv.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Historietank
programme.desc: Meget er på spil, da Henry påstår, at han ikke kan blive bange. Schwoz bruger en maskine, som virtuelt lader Henry opleve de uhyggelige historier, som alle i Mandehulen fortæller ham i et forsøg på at vise Henry, at han tager fejl.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Højtidstæsk
programme.desc: En ny art af møl æder alle juletræerne i Swellview, så Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen tager til Nabostrup for at købe nogle flere. På vejen hjem bliver de angrebet af nogle luskede træhandlere og må kæmpe for at redde julen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Misundelsesmuren
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen holder vagt ved Swellviews nyeste attraktion, Misundelsesmuren, da Kaptajn Mand ødelægger muren i et forsøg på at eliminere en lille fugl. Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand må nu finde en måde at erstatte den på.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hr. Flinkofyr
programme.desc: En selvtægtsudøver iklædt en smiley-fjæs-maske straffer indbyggere i Swellview for uhøflig optræden. Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mands undersøgelser leder dem til et TV-studie ejet af den kendte børneprogramsvært hr. Wallabee.

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna er skyld i en ulykke på skolen, som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvenserne af konfrontationen med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna In Wonderland
programme.desc: Mens Jenna nyder lidt popularitet, har Matty det svært med at blive holdt uden for. Samtidig bager Jake på den nye pige, og Ally holder en sexlege-fest.

programme.desc: En storm blæser scenen i stykker inden en stor koncert. Kan Paw Patrol redde dagen? // Vovserne redder en ørn, der sidder fast i sin egen rede.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne og Piratskatten
programme.desc: Kaptajn Pighvar falder tilfældigt i en hemmelig hule, der engang var gemmested for en sørøver. Da Paw Patrol redder ham, finder de et ufuldstændigt skattekort.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne Redder Julen
programme.desc: Julemandens kane er strandet og rensdyrene stukket af. Ryder og Paw Patrol må hjælpe julemanden med at aflevere gaverne og redde julen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne Redder Hundekiks / Vovserne får et Lift
programme.desc: Paw Patrol skal bringe Hr. Porters lastbil med hundekiks i sikkerhed, da den er strandet på isen. // Paw Patrol må redde Katie og Cali, da skiliften på bjerget har sat sig fast.

programme.title: iCarly: Dingo-tyveri
programme.desc: Dingo-kanalen har stjålet idéer fra iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer tager hen i Dingo-studiet for at sige, hvad de mener om det.

programme.title: iCarly: Vennekys
programme.desc: Da Sam kommer til at afsløre over for Carly, at hun og Freddie kyssede i smug, konfronterer Carly dem om, hvorfor de ikke fortalte hende det. Og Spencer underviser fængselsfanger i billedkunst.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi laver mad
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie besejrer en berømt tv-kok i en madlavningskonkurrence, vil kokken ikke lave mad mere og nægter at komme ud af sit soveværelse. Spencer prøver at opfylde sin fremtidsdrøm.

programme.title: iCarly: En rektor med karakter
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie får rektor Franklin fyret, overtager miss Briggs og mr. Howard ledelsen og indfører strenge regler. Og Spencer hyrer en gammel rodeostjerne til at lære ham at ride på en mekanisk tyr.

programme.title: iCarly: Find en fyr til Carly
programme.desc: Så mange drenge dukker op til 'tag Carly med til fest'-konkurrencen, at Carly, Sam og Freddie må benytte speed-dating for at møde dem alle sammen. Spencer følger et ejendommeligt træningsprogram fra en ny app.

programme.title: iCarly: Stjernefiasko
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie skal lave en musikvideo til en popstjernes comeback, opdager de, at popstjernen er ude af form og talentløs. Og Spencer opdager, at kvinden, han dater, er Gibbys mor.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg reddede dit liv
programme.desc: Da Freddie redder Carlys liv, forelsker Carly sig i ham. Sam og Spencer dyster mod hinanden i paintball-spillet Assassin.

programme.title: iCarly: Lewberts gamle flamme
programme.desc: Da slænget opdager, at Lewbert engang var en lykkelig ung mand, som var forlovet med en smuk kvinde, sætter de sig for at forene det adskilte par.

programme.title: iCarly: Skønhedskonkurrencen
programme.desc: Sam afslører over for Carly og Freddie, at hun deltog i skønhedskonkurrencer som lille. Da hun finder ud af, at hendes rival skal konkurrere i Seattle, overbeviser hun Carly om at stille op imod hende.

programme.title: iCarly: Et usædvanligt webshow
programme.desc: Efter Sam pludselig bliver tvunget i fængsel, lover Carly og Freddie ikke at aflyse netshowet, fordi hendes far skal se det. Hun beder Spencer om hjælp, men det bliver svært, for han skal på date.
